name: GPU-Enabled Jupyter Notebook (Axolotl/PyTorch)
description: Jupyter notebook environment pre-loaded with Axolotl for LLM fine-tuning, LoRA training, and general GPU-accelerated development.

development.notes: General GPU development without large models

healthcheck.reason: Jupyter serves its UI immediately on startup. No model loading delay.

startup_behavior.description: Jupyter server starts immediately. User interacts via browser. Training happens on-demand inside notebook cells.

common_failures.description: Training job inside notebook exceeds VRAM
common_failures.mitigation: Use gradient checkpointing, reduce batch size, or use LoRA instead of full fine-tuning

common_failures.description: Training runs can take hours; default timeout too short
common_failures.mitigation: Set timeout >= 7200s or use SIMPLE-EXTEND strategy

security_warnings: Default template disables Jupyter authentication (--ServerApp.token='' --ServerApp.password=''). For production, set a token via Nosana secrets: ["nosana/jupyter-token"]

timeout_characteristics.timeout_reason: Training sessions have defined duration; SIMPLE-EXTEND is sufficient
